name: Canadian Citizenship by Naturalization

requirements.blocker_text: This requires 1,095 days of physical presence in Canada within the 5 years before applying, calculated as a PR — pre-PR days count as half-days up to a maximum credit of 365 days.
This requires English or French at CLB 4 (for applicants aged 18-54).
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved language test at CLB 4.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires passing the citizenship test (20 questions, pass at 15/20), typically administered online, for applicants aged 18-54.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare for and pass the citizenship test.

evidence_required.document: Approved language test result at CLB 4
3 of the 5 years' tax filing evidence, if required

notes: CLARIFICATION on the physical-presence formula: 1,095 days (3 years) within the 5 years before applying — minimum_months_held (36) reflects this, though the ACTUAL calculation is in days with partial pre-PR credit, not a flat 36-month PR-holding requirement. Fee: $630 ($530 processing + $100 Right of Citizenship), though several sources report the Right of Citizenship Fee rising to $123 from 31 March 2026 ($653 total) — flagged as needing direct confirmation against canada.ca before treating as settled. Dual citizenship permitted, confirmed.
